facts.fact: The page states that ConvertKit offers a 99.73% deliverability rate; it gives no source or measurement method for this figure.
facts.quote: ConvertKit offers a stellar 99.73% deliverability rate and easy automation.

facts.fact: The page states that ConvertKit offers a 99.73% email delivery rate and a free plan for up to 1,000 subscribers.
facts.quote: ConvertKit offers a 99.73% email delivery rate and automates campaigns for content creators with a free plan for up to 1,000 subscribers.

facts.fact: The page states that Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) allows sending up to 300 emails per day for free.
facts.quote: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) allows sending up to 300 emails daily for free and offers advanced segmentation tools.

facts.fact: The page states, without naming a source, that 63% of marketers already use AI for personalized email content.
facts.quote: With 63% of marketers already using AI for this purpose, it's clear that the technology works.

facts.fact: The page states, without naming a source, that 90% of marketers report improved content quality and customer engagement from data-driven AI insights.
facts.quote: with 90% of marketers noting improved content quality and customer engagement.
